name: RPi4_UEFI_Firmware_v1.53
purpose: The Raspberry Pi 4 Model B's device tree as the Raspberry Pi firmware ships it (plan step H7.2), which QEMU's raspi4b takes with -dtb, as H0.2 measured it: the archive of pftf/RPi4 v1.53 by its SHA-256, of which setup extracts the board's tree alone. The files beside the UEFI image are under the Raspberry Pi boot files' terms, which the archive's Readme.md names; WitOS ships none of them.
